metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.8 · 2007 · The Man from Earth
metas.description: An impromptu goodbye party for Professor John Oldman becomes a mysterious interrogation after the retiring scholar reveals to his colleagues he has a longer and stranger past than they can imagine.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.2 · 2017 · The Man from Earth: Holocene
metas.description: A 14,000-year-old college professor notices that he has finally started showing signs of aging. Meanwhile, four of his students get suspicious of him and start investigating his past.
